name: Australia
gaps: Sunshine Coast (QLD): the local sub branch only has an inactive looking blog, so its parent BirdLife Southern QLD is listed instead.
Christmas Island, Cocos (Keeling) Islands and Norfolk Island have no findable club of their own; they fall under BirdLife Western Australia and BirdLife Australia's national programmes.

Birding NSW (the Sydney based field ornithologists club, birdingnsw.org.au) is real and active but its site only serves over a broken, self signed https certificate, so it is left off rather than linked insecurely.

name: Marshall Islands

name: New Zealand
gaps: The New Zealand Bird Atlas is run through eBird's atlasnz portal, so as a global platform page it is not listed here even though it is the count NZ birders actually use.

Birds New Zealand has branches in several more regions (Far North, South Auckland, Gisborne/Wairoa, Taranaki, Whanganui, Wairarapa, Marlborough, West Coast) beyond the ones listed, each reachable from the society's own find your region page.

name: Papua New Guinea
gaps: No dedicated birding club or society with its own public presence was found for Papua New Guinea, and it has no BirdLife International partner. The Papua New Guinea Institute of Biological Research does biodiversity research but has no public birding membership programme, so it is left out rather than included on a stretch.
